title: Shop calendar (opening days & local events)
summary: Daily shop calendar covering 2022-01-01 to present (still updating), with one row per day. Records whether the shop was open (is_open boolean) and any local event taking place (event_name free-text string). Matches need N5 (shop opening days and local events) at daily grain. Refresh cadence is weekly — most recent week may be stale by a few days. Event descriptions are self-reported by the shop and may be incomplete (not systematically sourced from all municipalities).

fields.name: event_name
fields.description: Local event that day, if any

schema.notes: event_name is free-text; only populated when a local event occurs that day. No controlled vocabulary for event types.

spatial.notes: Single shop location in Italy (Valdena Gelato). No explicit geography column; the shop location is implicit.

documentation_excerpts: Opening days, closures and local events for the shop. — catalog description
